snippet.title: Thoda Magar Roz! Allah Ko Sab Se Pyara Amal | Sahih Muslim 783 #shorts
snippet.description:
Roz ek ghanta? Ya roz sirf do minute? Allah ko kya zyada pasand hai?

Hazrat Aisha Radi Allahu Anha bayan karti hain, ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ»
"Allah ko sab se pyare amal woh hain, jo hamesha kiye jayen, chahe thode hon."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 783: https://sunnah.com/muslim:783b

Yaani ek din bohat zyada, phir chhod dena, nahin. Balke thoda, magar roz: roz do rakat nafl, roz ek safha Quran, roz ek chhota sa sadqah. Comment mein likhein, aap roz kaun sa ek amal karenge? Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: muhammadarhamamin77800 on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-198164/)
